note: The UAL megafiles are build INPUTS, not deliverables — 20 MB each, of which three quarters is animation data any given app will not play. They are simply not in `publish`, so they never reach the CDN; the curated subset built into derived/ is the deliverable. characters/ and hairstyles/ are pushed as-is for now and are the obvious next candidates for the library treatment (see CONTENT-MAP.md).
